description: A markdown handoff of a stretch of work, for whoever picks it up next. Without text: the facts for the range (steps, decisions, open items, commits, files). Write the handoff from them, then call again with text and title to save it for the dashboard.

commits.description: Exactly these commits, instead of a range.

since.description: A date (2026-11-01) or a commit to start after; the last handoff when left out.

text.description: The handoff you wrote, in markdown.

until.description: A date to end at; now when left out.

name: handoff
title: Handoff
